name: hengmu
description: Evidence-bound architecture review and target design for Codex and compatible Agent Plugins: verification, decisions, remediation plans, portfolio review, and deterministic quality gates.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-bound architecture review for Codex and Agent Plugins
interface.longDescription: Assess repositories and portfolios, design open or constrained target architectures, compare architecture and technology options, verify evidence and provenance, record decisions, plan remediation or Greenfield implementation, and enforce trusted artifacts with layered deterministic policy. Hengmu ships a native Codex package and a portable Agent Plugins package for compatible hosts such as Cursor. It proposes artifacts; it does not accept decisions, implement application code, or run gates implicitly. Local helpers require Python 3.11–3.13 with PyYAML and jsonschema.
defaultPrompt: Use $hengmu to show the available engineering workflows for this repository.
Use $hengmu to audit this repository and verify every architecture finding.
Use $hengmu to design an open or constrained target from an approved Brief and record a proposed decision.
